name: 机圈验机报告
description: 一句话生成新机/二手机验机报告，汇总设备、系统、屏幕、电池、传感器、Camera2、Widevine、存储测速和预装应用关注项，输出适合酷安截图分享的重点报告。
description_en: Generate a phone inspection report for new/used devices with device, OS, display, battery, sensors, Camera2, Widevine, storage speed, and preinstalled app highlights.

permissions.name: android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES
permissions.desc: 用于统计已安装应用数量并识别预装应用关注项
permissions.desc_en: Count installed apps and identify preinstalled app highlights

apis.name: generateInspectionReport
apis.desc: 生成新机/二手机验机报告，适用于“帮我做一次新机验机，生成酷安发帖报告”等提示词
apis.desc_en: Generate a new/used phone inspection report for Coolapk-style sharing
paramDesc: 是否执行轻量存储读写测速，默认 true
paramDesc_en: Run a lightweight storage read/write test, default true
examples: 帮我做一次新机验机，生成酷安发帖报告
刷机后帮我复测手机状态

apis.name: generateAiInspectionAdvice
apis.desc: 生成验机报告后调用 AI 给出更自然的购机、验机或发帖建议
apis.desc_en: Generate an inspection report and use AI to provide readable buying, checking, or posting advice
paramDesc: 是否执行轻量存储读写测速，默认 true
额外要求，例如 二手机验机重点/酷安发帖语气
输出语言：zh/en，默认自动判断
最大输出 token，默认 768，上限 1024
paramDesc_en: Run a lightweight storage read/write test, default true
Extra instruction such as used-phone checks or Coolapk post tone
Output language: zh/en, auto-detected by default
Max output tokens, default 768, capped at 1024
examples: 帮我做一次二手机验机，并总结风险点
生成适合酷安发帖的验机结论
刷机后复测手机状态并给建议

apis.name: runStorageSpeedTest
apis.desc: 执行轻量存储读写测速并输出可读结论
apis.desc_en: Run a lightweight storage read/write speed test
paramDesc: 测试文件大小 MB，默认 16，范围 4-64
paramDesc_en: Test file size in MB, default 16, range 4-64

apis.name: getDeviceArchive
apis.desc: 读取最近一次验机报告，用于复测对比或生成长图
apis.desc_en: Read the latest inspection report for retest comparison or long image generation
